text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from 102,951 to 96,836 overall, so occasional rebounds have not erased the need to review risk and protect money I may need for living expenses.","Doing nothing avoids impulsive trades, but it does not manage risk by itself; I should check whether my holdings and cash remain suitably balanced for retirement.","A stock’s gain or loss versus my purchase cost is not, by itself, a reason to sell or hold; I should make deliberate decisions based on my overall plan."]}
